name: Photo Stitch
desc: Join photos vertically, side by side or in a grid.
about: Put several photos into one image: stacked, side by side or in a grid, with borders, gaps and an exact output size. Everything happens in your browser.

intents.phrase: …put several photos together into one picture
intents.desc: Stacked, side by side or in a grid, with gaps, borders and an exact size. Nothing leaves your phone.
